::: {.ref-description}
Reads are sorted by leftmost coordinates, or by read name when `--sort_by_read_names` is used.

An appropriate `@HD-SO` sort order header tag will be added or an existing one updated if necessary.

Note that to generate an index file (by specifying `--output_bai`), the default coordinate sort must be used.
Thus the `--sort_by_read_names` and `--sort_by <TAG>` options are incompatible with `--output_bai`.
:::

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--minimizer_cluster`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Sort unmapped reads (those in chromosome "*") by their sequence minimiser (Schleimer et al., 2003; Roberts et al., 2004),
also reverse complementing as appropriate. This has the effect of collating some similar data together, improving the
compressibility of the unmapped sequence. The minimiser kmer size is adjusted using the -K option. Note data compressed
in this manner may need to be name collated prior to conversion back to fastq.

Mapped sequences are sorted by chromosome and position.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--minimizer_kmer`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Sets the kmer size to be used in the -M option.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Example]{.arg-key} `20`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--sort_by_read_names`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Sort by read names (i.e., the QNAME field) rather than by chromosomal coordinates.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--sort_by`

::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}

::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/mapping/samtools_sort/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/mapping/samtools_sort);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/mapping/samtools_sort/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
